prompt: I'm building a Python FastAPI service that needs to search documents stored in Valkey using vector embeddings. Write a function that takes a query embedding (as a list of floats) and returns the top 5 similar documents. The index is called 'docs_idx' and I need to handle the binary data correctly. Also make sure to decode the results properly so I can return them as JSON from my API endpoint.

assertions.name: Uses async client with context manager
assertions.description: Code should use 'async with GlideClient' or 'async with GlideClusterClient' for automatic cleanup

assertions.name: Uses ft.search with proper imports
assertions.description: Should import ft from glide/glide_sync and call ft.search(client=..., index_name=..., query=..., options=...)

assertions.name: Decodes bytes to strings
assertions.description: Should decode bytes results to strings for JSON serialization, handling both keys and field values

assertions.name: Skips binary embedding field
assertions.description: Should skip or handle binary fields like 'embedding' that cannot be decoded as UTF-8

assertions.name: Uses FtSearchOptions with params
assertions.description: Should wrap search params in FtSearchOptions(params={...})
